svg.text: Adjustable RGB and induction envelopes / optional depth device is unbuilt / opaque hood panels omitted
SENSOR SIDE / selected physical solids, covers omitted / 1:10
Remove the left access panel, withdraw locating pins and disconnect connectors. Reserve an engineered isolation
procedure. This drawing checks clearance only, not safe servicing.
LIFT-OFF IS NOT THIS HOUSING GAP
Selected housing-to-window gap: 8 mm, packaging only. Coil plane, belt/window effects and object shape require
TRANSVERSE VIEW / sensor selection, viewed along +X / 1:10
400 mm optical coverage is an example, not full 600 mm belt coverage. The separate 500 mm effective-width calculation is
an assumption. Usable sensing width is TBD.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
